title: Erin Patterson, Woman Convicted in Australia’s Mushroom Murder Case, Appeals
summary_full: An Australian woman, Erin Patterson, was found guilty of murdering three of her husband’s relatives and trying to kill a fourth by serving them deadly mushrooms.
